message: Analogue inputs are TCWV, 1/3/7-day rainfall percentiles, topsoil and 1-day discharge rise; monsoon_day is absent
LOEO covers 19 training events at onset-1 and onset-2 for both windows; held-out events are excluded
Window selection follows training LOEO hit rate and the shorter-window tie rule: 14 days
Final daily-match standardization uses only 2001–2019 monsoon data
Daily analogues use complete selected-length templates and September 2024 uses pre-2024 events only
September representative matches reproduce; 356 incomplete windows remain unmatched
